svg.aria-label: The Virtual View Manifesto. Stop treating SQL views like decoration. Use them as data contracts for apps and agents. 8 organizing principles: views belong to apps and agents; every view has multiple versions; apps usually query views; every view has one owner; never change column types; use invoker permissions; store views in one canonical place; map complexity, don't memorize it. A layer cake in section: postgresql.myapp.* tables, base views, a versioned layer, and myapp.* views; the versioned layer and base views are each a replaceable layer, with a lit candle for apps and agents running queries. Shaded parts mark test data in every layer. Three panels: 1, view hierarchy in service, orders served from v1: stable views as data contract, pointing at myapp.*. 2, zero-downtime migration, running queries keep v1: orders_v2 swapped into the middle layer as orders_v1 floats out, swap in new version. 3, Iceberg scale-out, federation between PG and Iceberg, with base views v3 and iceberg.myapp.* added below postgresql: add iceberg storage layer. Three phases, no downtime, no one changed the app. Title block: virtual-view-manifesto, version v0.70, scale enterprise, revision date 2026-10-12, license CC0.
